caption: The drawing shows a large, brown, stoneware jug with a rounded body that narrows to a short neck and a narrow rim. The jug has a textured surface with dark speckles and features hand-painted blue decorative motifs, including abstract curved shapes and floral elements on the front. Near the top, the text "Luke School 1839" is inscribed within a decorative, scalloped border. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset image showing the jug at a slight angle from above, which reveals a single curved handle attached to the neck and shoulder of the jug, as well as additional blue decorations just below the rim. The artist's signature "N. Amantea" is located in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is plain and light-colored, with a thin outlined border framing both the main image and the inset.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
